body: Here’s the beautiful new UK cover for my upcoming book, Do I Stay Christian? I’m impressed with both the US and UK versions! The book won’t be out until May – but it could be a good Christmas present that comes with a free gift of five months of anticipation. Of course, my January 2021 release Faith After Doubt is available now – in print, ebook, and audiobook formats.
